mapper.select: SELECT r.chat_recommendation_no, r.scenario_no, r.label, r.priority, r.use_yn, r.frst_reg_dt, r.lst_chg_dt FROM tb_chat_recommendation r JOIN tb_scenario s ON s.scenario_no = r.scenario_no JOIN tb_scenario_category c ON c.scenario_category_no = s.category_no WHERE r.use_yn = 'Y' AND s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND s.active_version_no IS NOT NULL AND c.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY r.priority, r.chat_recommendation_no

SELECT r.chat_recommendation_no, r.scenario_no, s.title AS scenario_title, r.label, r.priority, r.use_yn, r.frst_reg_dt, r.lst_chg_dt FROM tb_chat_recommendation r JOIN tb_scenario s ON s.scenario_no = r.scenario_no
r.use_yn = 'Y''N'
ORDER BY r.priority, r.chat_recommendation_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_chat_recommendation (scenario_no, label, priority, use_yn) VALUES (#{scenarioNo}, #{label}, #{priority}, #{useYn})
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_chat_recommendation SET scenario_no = #{scenarioNo}, label = #{label}, priority = #{priority}, use_yn = #{useYn}, lst_chg_dt = now() WHERE chat_recommendation_no = #{id}
